rule.assistant_manager: Assistant manager — share of team sales

ruleHelp.manager_sale: The manager receives this percentage of each product's selling price. If a product defines its own manager share, that value takes precedence.
ruleHelp.assistant_manager: The assistant manager receives a share based on team sales, deducted from the selling manager's compensation.
ruleHelp.manager_office: The creator/manager of an office receives this percentage of the sales of the office they opened directly.
ruleHelp.manager_descendant_office: The manager receives this percentage of sales from descendant offices (offices opened by their guys).
ruleHelp.divisionnaire_office: The divisionnaire receives this percentage of sales from offices in their hierarchy.
ruleHelp.secretary_office: The secretary receives this percentage of sales from the office opened by the manager they accompany. A fixed salary may be added separately.

ruleScope.manager_direct_office: Office opened by the accompanied manager
